test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

When he was falsely accused of embezzlement, __he was beside himself__ in anger.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'beside himself in anger' is correct.
 
• The phrase **'beside himself'** means to be extremely agitated or upset.
 
• There is no grammatical error in the use of **'was'** in this context.
 
• Therefore, the sentence does not require any improvement.

Hence, the correct statement is** '*When he was falsely accused of embezzlement, he was beside himself in anger*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase **'beside himself'** is an** idiom** meaning** to be overwhelmed with emotion, typically negative emotions like anger or grief.**
 
• It is** important to understand idiomatic expression**s to avoid misinterpretation and incorrect grammatical corrections.
